levels.title: Level 1 — Home Row
levels.description: Anchor index fingers on F and J and build muscle memory across the home row.
levels.ergonomicTip: Keep wrists neutral and hover lightly above the desk. Rest index fingers gently on the tactile bumps of F and J.

lessons.title: 1.1 F & J Anchors
lessons.description: Establish tactile home position on F and J.
lessons.practiceText: fff jjj fjf jfj ff jj fjfj jfjf fff jjj fjf jfj

lessons.title: 1.2 D & K Reach
lessons.description: Train middle fingers cleanly on D and K.
lessons.practiceText: ddd kkk dfd jkj ddd kkk fkf jdj dfjk kjfd ddkk fjdk

lessons.title: 1.3 S & L Keys
lessons.description: Develop ring-finger control with S and L.
lessons.practiceText: sss lll sld kls asdf jkl sad lad fall ask flask lass

lessons.title: 1.4 A, G, H & ;
lessons.description: Extend outer pinky and center index home-row keys.
lessons.practiceText: aaa ;;; ggg hhh glad half dash flash hall ash shall ask;

levels.title: Level 2 — Top Row
levels.description: Reach upward cleanly from the home row and return to F and J anchors.
levels.ergonomicTip: Move individual fingers upward while keeping the other fingertips hovering over home row.

lessons.title: 2.1 E & I Upward
lessons.description: Middle-finger reaches to E and I.
lessons.practiceText: ded kik feel like kid slide life desk side idle file

lessons.title: 2.2 R, T, U & Y
lessons.description: Index-finger reaches across the upper center.
lessons.practiceText: frf juj run fur rule true user sure fire lure try duty

lessons.title: 2.3 Q, W, O & P
lessons.description: Outer top-row reaches with ring and pinky fingers.
lessons.practiceText: work word slow power quote equip follow people quiet wood

levels.title: Level 3 — Bottom Row
levels.description: Execute downward reaches while maintaining steady wrist posture.
levels.ergonomicTip: Curl fingers softly toward the bottom row rather than sliding your palms backward.

lessons.title: 3.1 C, V, N & M
lessons.description: Center bottom-row reaches and common bigrams.
lessons.practiceText: calm mind move fine line come name near live even main

lessons.title: 3.2 Z, X, B & Punctuation
lessons.description: Complete the alphabet with Z, X, B, comma, period, and slash.
lessons.practiceText: zero exact box, brave climb, next zone. fixed size, bold.

levels.title: Level 4 — Number Row
levels.description: Build confidence reaching to digits 0 through 9 without glancing down.
levels.ergonomicTip: Anchor your opposite hand lightly while reaching high to the number row.

lessons.title: 4.1 Digits 1 to 5
lessons.description: Left-hand number reaches paired with common words.
lessons.practiceText: 10 24 35 42 51 order 14 files and 23 items in 5 rooms

lessons.title: 4.2 Digits 6 to 0
lessons.description: Right-hand number reaches in realistic quantities.

levels.title: Level 5 — Punctuation
levels.description: Master brackets, quotes, hyphens, and punctuation rhythm.
levels.ergonomicTip: Keep pinky reaches smooth and avoid twisting your right wrist toward Enter.

lessons.title: 5.1 Quotes, Colons & Hyphens
lessons.practiceText: note: use 'clean-flow' speed; ask why? stay calm! done.

levels.title: Level 6 — Capital Letters
levels.description: Practice smooth opposite-hand Shift coordination for uppercase text.
levels.ergonomicTip: Always hold Shift with the opposite hand from the letter being capitalized.

lessons.title: 6.1 Left & Right Shift Sync
lessons.description: Proper nouns and clean sentence capitalization.
lessons.practiceText: Alice and David met Mark in Seattle. TypeForge runs fast.

levels.title: Level 7 — Combined Practice
levels.description: Sustained multi-skill fluency combining letters, numbers, capitals, and punctuation.
levels.ergonomicTip: Prioritize even cadence over bursts; steady rhythm naturally compounds speed.

lessons.title: 7.1 Full Keyboard Fluency
lessons.description: Mixed prose and technical phrasing for capstone mastery.
lessons.practiceText: Build #42 passed in 18s: TypeForge measured 74 WPM at 98.5% precision.
